name: Blackrock Caverns: the decorative Twilight Element Warden corpses cannot be attacked (#11373)
contract: Twilight Element Warden 40017 spawns 6450150-6450153 outside Beauty's arena carry the Permanent Feign Death addon aura 29266 as decorative corpses, while the same template is the live warden at 6450154-6450167. Feign death does not make a creature unattackable, so the corpse spawns authored with unit_flags 0 could be attacked, leaving the attacker in combat. Each corpse spawn now carries UNIT_FLAG_NON_ATTACKABLE (2), the flag Galaen's Corpse 17508 carries on its template, and the live warden spawn stays attackable.

steps.label: CONTROL: the player is inside Blackrock Caverns
The player joins world phase 1, where the dungeon spawns live
The corpse spawn 6450150 is loaded beside the player
Let the spawn addon auras apply
DISCRIMINATING: the player cannot attack the decorative corpse 6450150
The player walks to the live warden 6450155
CONTROL: the player can attack the live warden 6450155
